title: AMD shares its third quarter results today after the close
summary: AMD said it would report third quarter results on Tuesday, November 3, after the market closes, with a call at 5 p.m. Eastern. In its last report the company said it expected about $13 billion in sales this quarter, give or take $300 million.
why: A company's own forecast is a yardstick. When the real numbers come out, investors compare them with that range and with what they hoped for. A stock can fall even on good results if people hoped for more, so a big move in either direction is possible.

title: Tech and AI related stocks bounced back on Tuesday
summary: After a rough Monday, several big technology and AI related companies climbed. Vertiv, Rocket Lab, Microsoft, Meta, Nvidia and Amazon all gained between about 2% and 5%. Across Nasdaq companies, tech rose about 0.9% and industrial firms rose about 1.6%.
why: Stocks that rise and fall together are tied to the same story, here the excitement around AI. A rebound after a drop is normal, but it does not mean the worry is over. It is a reminder that prices of fast growing companies swing a lot.
source: Financial Modeling Prep sector performance and quotes

title: The 10 year Treasury yield rose to 4.95%
summary: The interest rate on 10 year U.S. government bonds ticked up from 4.91% on Monday to 4.95% on Tuesday. It remains lower than the 5.05% seen on October 28.
why: The 10 year yield is like the price of borrowing money for a long time. When it goes up, new bonds pay more, so stocks have to look more attractive to compete. Fast growing companies are often the most sensitive to this.
source: U.S. Treasury daily yield curve rates

title: The Treasury announces how much it plans to borrow on Wednesday
summary: The U.S. Treasury said it will give its quarterly update on Wednesday, November 4. It tells investors how much money the government plans to borrow through bonds in the coming months.
why: If the government borrows more, there are more bonds for investors to buy, and that can push bond interest rates up. Higher rates can affect how investors value stocks, so people watch this announcement closely.
